meta.name: brandkit
meta.description: Premium brand-kit image generation skill for creating high-end brand-guidelines boards, logo systems, identity decks, and visual-world presentations. Trained for minimalist, cinematic, editorial, dark-tech, luxury, cultural, security, gaming, developer-tool, and consumer-app brand systems. Optimized for intentional logo concepting, refined composition, sparse typography, strong symbolic meaning, premium mockups, art-directed imagery, and flexible grid layouts.

howto.what: Claude 会以品牌视觉总监的方式生成品牌套件图片:logo 方案、身份板、应用样机、配色与排版。默认输出一张 3×3 网格的品牌总览图。
howto.when: 当你要求做品牌指南板、logo 系统或身份牌时接管;未指定布局时默认生成一张 3×3 总览图。

howto.what_en: Claude acts as a brand art director and generates brand-kit images: logo systems, identity boards, mockups, palettes and type. Default output is one 3x3 overview board.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask for brand-guidelines boards, logo systems or identity decks; with no layout given it defaults to one 3x3 board.
